# `web_verifyValue`

Assert an element's text, form-field value, or HTML attribute value.

## Source

- Kind: class-backed
- Class: `xyz.block.trailblaze.playwright.tools.PlaywrightNativeVerifyValueTool`

## Contract

- Visible to LLM: yes (`surface_to_llm: true`)
- Recordable: yes (`is_recordable: true`)
- Host-only: no (`requires_host: false`)

## Input schema

### Required parameters

- `expected` — `String`
  Expected value.

### Optional parameters

- `ref` — `String`
  Element ID ('e5'), ARIA descriptor ('textbox "Email"'), or 'css=<selector>'.
- `type` — `enum(TEXT | VALUE | ATTRIBUTE)`
  TEXT: element text contains expected (falls back to the field value). VALUE: input/textarea/select value equals it. ATTRIBUTE: the named attribute equals it.
- `attribute` — `String`
  Attribute name, when type is ATTRIBUTE.
- `reasoning` — `String`

## Output

Returns: `string` (opaque text content)
